title: The gateway has no Anthropic door and no Responses door
summary: SpiderGate speaks OpenAI chat-completions only: /chat/completions, /embeddings, images, audio, media and /models. /messages, /responses and the legacy /completions are 404 (probed live). So Claude Code (needs /v1/messages) and Codex CLI (responses only) cannot use it, and Cursor works in Ask/chat mode only. Do not list an agent the gateway cannot serve.
